name: colmaps
description: > A high-performance and accessible Web GIS prototype for exploring tourist routes and points of interest in Colombia.

scripts.docker:build: docker compose --parallel 1 build data-pipeline && docker compose --parallel 1 build data-import && docker compose --parallel 1 build backend && docker compose --parallel 1 build frontend
scripts.docker:up: npm run docker:build && docker compose --parallel 1 up -d --no-build
